_routing_comment: The retrieval router (015, src/rag/route.ts). Each case asserts the
ROUTE the preview reports, which is what the chat path would do.
NOTE A DELIBERATE DEPARTURE FROM docs/business-profile.md. That brief
asks for profile-answerable questions (hours, address, phone,
booking) asserting route 'skip'. They do not skip, and must not: the
router explicitly does NOT do intent detection, because /what.*hours/i
will never match 你们几点开门 and the prompt tells the model to answer
in the visitor's own language. What makes those questions cheap is
that the PROFILE IS ALWAYS IN THE PROMPT, not that anything
So `profile` below asserts the opposite of the brief, and asserting
it is the point: it is the regression test that stops someone
'finishing' the router with a bag of intent regexes and quietly
making the bot stop answering its most common questions.
